title: Aromatic Snappy Brazilian Lamb Pasta
description: A flavorful and savory Brazilian dish featuring lamb, pasta, and a unique pasta-water emulsion, designed to cure hangovers and align with ayurvedic tamasic principles.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear the lamb pieces until browned on all sides.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until translucent, then add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the coconut milk, tomato paste, cumin, salt, and black pepper, and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Reserve 1 cup of pasta water before draining the cooked pasta, then add the pasta to the skillet with the lamb and sauce.
Add the reserved pasta water to the skillet in small increments, stirring constantly, until the sauce reaches the desired consistency.
Serve the pasta hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
